captions_meta.hook: SMEs employ 71% of Singapore's workforce. Yet most of their news never gets published. 🤔
lines: • They employ 71% of the total workforce
A regional expansion, a new grant-funded product, 30 new hires: all newsworthy.
They just rarely reach a newsroom in a usable format.
captions_meta.li_hook:
SMEs make up 99% of Singapore's businesses and employ 71% of its workforce.
They account for a much smaller share of business coverage.
li_body: The figure, cited by MTI in November 2024, usually frames policy discussions. We read it as a communications gap: tens of thousands of firms whose milestones never reach a journalist.

Not because they lack news value, but because they are not packaged as news. A first overseas office, a new product or a sizeable hiring round is a strong story when it comes with clear numbers and a quotable spokesperson.
captions_meta.li_close: If you run an SME: which milestone from this year should the market know about?
captions_meta.fb: Fun fact: SMEs employ 71% of Singapore's workforce. If you run one, your news deserves coverage too 💙
